answer: Run an audit lottery. Each epoch the node draws a random slice of identities to be re-checked by independent peers; the auditor stakes a small fee, refunded if the answer holds, and takes the audited identity's bond if it fails. A farm cannot know which puppets are drawn, so every one must behave correctly, paying the full cost of genuine work instead of a flat fee per wallet. The selecting beacon is public and unpredictable, so no farm can stage a meadow where only its puppets graze. Failures drain bonds faster than a hollow shell of cheap identities can be rebuilt, so scale stops helping.
